title.en: Find OSPF packets in the capture

why.en: OSPF runs directly over IP (protocol 89), so there is no TCP or UDP port to filter on.
why.hinglish: OSPF seedha IP (protocol 89) par chalta hai, isliye filter karne ke liye koi TCP ya UDP port nahi hota.

expect.en: You see Hello, DB Description, LS Request, LS Update and LS Acknowledge packets. Addresses and timing differ in your copy.
expect.hinglish: Tumhe Hello, DB Description, LS Request, LS Update aur LS Acknowledge packets dikhenge. Tumhari copy mein addresses aur timing alag ho sakti hai.

why.en: Hello packets are type 1; they carry the timers, DR and neighbour list.
why.hinglish: Hello packets type 1 hote hain; inme timers, DR aur neighbour list hoti hai.

expect.en: Each Hello shows Hello Interval 10 s and Dead Interval 40 s, plus the Designated Router and the neighbours it has heard.
expect.hinglish: Har Hello mein Hello Interval 10 s aur Dead Interval 40 s dikhta hai, saath mein Designated Router aur jin neighbours ko usne suna unki list.

why.en: Link State Updates (type 4) carry the full LSAs.
why.hinglish: Link State Updates (type 4) mein poore LSAs hote hain.

expect.en: Each update lists LSAs with their sequence numbers; in the link-down scenario you see the sequence numbers go up by one.
expect.hinglish: Har update mein LSAs unke sequence numbers ke saath hote hain; link-down scenario mein sequence numbers ek se badhte dikhte hain.

title.en: Look at your own routing table

why.en: Routes learnt from OSPF are marked O (Unix routers) in routing tables. A home PC usually has none, but this shows the table OSPF would fill.
why.hinglish: OSPF se seekhe gaye routes routing table mein O se mark hote hain. Ghar ke PC mein aksar nahi hote, lekin yeh wahi table dikhata hai jise OSPF bharta.

expect.en: A list of destinations, gateways and metrics. It varies by machine; on a home PC you only see a default route and local networks.
expect.hinglish: Destinations, gateways aur metrics ki list. Yeh machine ke hisaab se alag hoti hai; ghar ke PC par sirf default route aur local networks dikhte hain.
